items.title: Blixo vs Stripe Billing for SaaS Teams That Need Collections and Cash Application
items.summary: Key Takeaways Blixo automates cash application with machine learning for envelope and item matching. Stripe Billing leaves reconciliation manual, with no native engine. Stripe’s Smart Retry logic targets failed payments, but there’s no built-in workflow for the collections that come after dunning. Blixo runs on flat monthly fees, $49.99 or $99.99, with unlimited invoices. Stripe charges a percentage of recurring revenue plus processing fees. Blixo needs no code for core features and is built for finance teams. Stripe assumes medium-to-high dev resources for API customization. As of August 2026, Stripe sells revenue recognition as a separate product that has to integrate with billing. Blixo includes it. Blixo runs multi-channel collections across email, SMS, phone, and letters, with task assignment for AR teams throughout the process. Blixo’s white-label customer portal lets customers pay across all open invoices at once and manage subscriptions themselves, built in from day one. The five things that actually decide this When you’re evaluating what happens after the invoice goes out, five things matter: feature coverage, implementation complexity, pricing transparency, integration depth, and support model. items.title: What Is RPA in Accounts Receivable Automation
items.summary: Key Takeaways Many companies report rising late payments, which pushes RPA in accounts receivable from an experiment toward standard practice. Subscription invoices are structured, high-volume, and predictable — a strong fit for robotic process automation. Bots can match invoices and post payments faster than manual teams, compressing days-long cycles into shorter windows. Some organizations report shorter invoice processing time after automating AR workflows. RPA mimics human clicks across your billing and accounting systems to create, send, and reconcile invoices without touching a spreadsheet. A large share of the work in many finance departments is still manual, draining hours from tasks that repeat every cycle.
